name: Piper PA-38 Tomahawk
summary: Piper's T-tailed two-seat trainer of 1978–82, with a spinnable NASA GA(W)-1 wing and a large greenhouse cabin.

wings: Rectangular, constant-chord wing with squared tips
engines: Single flat-four in a short cowl with a sloping nose
fuselage: Large, rounded 'greenhouse' cabin with front-hinged doors
tail: T-tail with the stabilator on top of the fin

tellTales: T-tail on a small low-wing two-seater
Large rounded cabin glazing with two front-hinged doors
Sloping nose on fixed tricycle gear

confusedWith.howToTell: Both have T-tails; the Tomahawk has a more rounded, bubble-like greenhouse cabin, while the Skipper's cabin looks more conventional.
The Tomahawk is a low-wing with a T-tail; the 150 is a strut-braced high-wing with a conventional tail.
The Tomahawk is metal with a T-tail and a framed cabin; the DA20 is composite with a conventional tail and a clear bubble canopy.
The Tomahawk has a T-tail and hinged doors; the AA-5 has a conventional tail and a sliding canopy.
